title: Causal Intelligence AI Architecture
summary: Additive architecture knowledge for extending Joz from agentic retrieval into evidence-backed causal intelligence.

verification.notes: Additive architecture dataset based on the supplied causal knowledge graph and decision-intelligence specification. It describes an implementation framework, not personal production proof.

claims: Joz's architecture can extend the existing retrieval and agent runtime with a separate causal-intelligence service.
The semantic graph, causal engine, evidence store, and model versions should remain connected but distinct.
Causal discovery should produce candidate structures that require assumptions, review, and validation before causal claims are promoted.

causal_claims.subject: Semantic Knowledge Graph
assumptions: Graph relationships alone do not establish causal effects.

causal_claims.subject: Causal Discovery
assumptions: Observed data and domain constraints are available.

causal_claims.subject: Causal Claim
assumptions: Claims may be reviewed, refuted, versioned, and superseded.
